vaccines.name: Pfizer-BioNTech (BNT162b2/Comirnaty)
vaccines.description: Two-dose mRNA vaccine encoding the spike protein. EUA December 2020, full FDA approval August 2021.

vaccines.name: Moderna (mRNA-1273/Spikevax)
vaccines.description: Two-dose mRNA vaccine. EUA December 2020, full FDA approval January 2022.

vaccines.name: Johnson & Johnson (Ad26.COV2.S/Janssen)
vaccines.description: Single-dose adenovirus vector vaccine. EUA February 2021.

vaccines.name: Novavax (NVX-CoV2373)
vaccines.description: Two-dose protein subunit vaccine with Matrix-M adjuvant. EUA July 2022.

vaccines.name: AstraZeneca (ChAdOx1/Vaxzevria)
vaccines.description: Two-dose adenovirus vector vaccine. WHO EUL December 2020. Widely used globally.

vaccines.name: Sinovac (CoronaVac)
vaccines.description: Two-dose inactivated virus vaccine. WHO EUL June 2021. Widely used in Asia and South America.

vaccines.name: Sinopharm (BBIBP-CorV)
vaccines.description: Two-dose inactivated virus vaccine. WHO EUL May 2021.

vaccines.name: Covaxin (BBV152)
vaccines.description: Two-dose inactivated virus vaccine. WHO EUL November 2021.

vaccines.name: CanSino (Ad5-nCoV/Convidecia)
vaccines.description: Single-dose adenovirus vector vaccine. WHO EUL May 2022.

vaccines.name: Sputnik V (Gam-COVID-Vac)
vaccines.description: Two-dose heterologous adenovirus vaccine. Approved in Russia Feb 2020, 70+ countries.

vaccines.name: Medicago (CoVLP)
vaccines.description: Plant-derived COVID-19 vaccine candidate with GSK adjuvant.

vaccines.name: Sanofi-GSK (VAT00002)
vaccines.description: Recombinant protein vaccine with AS03 adjuvant.

vaccines.name: SK Bioscience (GBP510)
vaccines.description: Nanoparticle vaccine with GSK adjuvant. CEPI funded.

vaccines.name: Imperial College London
vaccines.description: Self-amplifying RNA vaccine requiring lower doses.

vaccines.name: Inovio (INO-4800)
vaccines.description: DNA plasmid vaccine delivered by electroporation.

treatments.name: Paxlovid (nirmatrelvir/ritonavir)
treatments.description: Oral antiviral combining nirmatrelvir (protease inhibitor) with ritonavir. EUA December 2021 for mild-to-moderate COVID-19 in high-risk patients.

treatments.name: Remdesivir (Veklury)
treatments.description: Intravenous antiviral. First FDA-approved treatment for COVID-19 (October 2020). For hospitalized patients.

treatments.name: Molnupiravir (Lagevrio)
treatments.description: Oral antiviral for mild-to-moderate COVID-19. EUA December 2021.

treatments.name: Dexamethasone
treatments.description: Standard of care for severe COVID-19 requiring oxygen. RECOVERY trial showed 35% mortality reduction.

treatments.name: Baricitinib (Olumiant)
treatments.description: JAK inhibitor for hospitalized adults requiring oxygen. FDA approved July 2022.

treatments.name: Tocilizumab (Actemra)
treatments.description: Monoclonal antibody blocking IL-6. EUA for hospitalized patients with inflammation.

treatments.name: Bebtelovimab
treatments.description: Monoclonal antibody retaining activity against Omicron. EUA February 2022.

treatments.name: Evusheld (tixagevimab/cilgavimab)
treatments.description: Pre-exposure prophylaxis for immunocompromised. EUA December 2021.

treatments.name: Enstilarelvir (Xocova)
treatments.description: Oral protease inhibitor. Approved in Japan November 2022.

treatments.name: Interferon-beta
treatments.description: Inhaled interferon for early COVID-19. Mixed trial results.

treatments.name: Convalescent Plasma
treatments.description: Plasma from recovered patients. EUA revoked; not recommended.

treatments.name: Hydroxychloroquine
treatments.description: Initially studied but found ineffective for COVID-19. EUA revoked June 2020.

treatments.name: Fluvoxamine
treatments.description: SSRI being studied for anti-inflammatory effects in COVID-19. TOGETHER trial showed benefit.

treatments.name: Ivermectin
treatments.description: Antiparasitic drug. Major clinical trials (ACTIV-6, TOGETHER) found no benefit for COVID-19.
